about: Persistent decision and moment echoes for Last Light Academy (doc 24 section 5.2 and section 5.4). Maps choice_id/option_id, moment_id, or required completed scene to later scene echoes ({scene_id, kind, target_id, text}). Chapter 1 pack covers D1 (EX-CH01-S01-CHOICE) and D2 (EX-CH01-S04-CHOICE). Chapters 2-8 pack (M3-95) covers D4-D13; D3 is the P-02 outcome, not a choice echo, and D8 has no scene echo.
consumer_rules: An echo fires only when its choice option (or moment, or required completed scene) is in story_log and the player is in its scene_id; it is never shown before then.
When an echo fires, its text becomes a 'Where it showed up again' line under the linked Decision entry.
choices, moments and scene_gated are lookup maps of the same rows listed in entries; the M1-50 check keeps them identical.

decisions.title: Where should spare commissioning energy go?
decisions.body: Routing spare sunlight to stored air or the planting bay saves a dated Day-one photo that returns in Chapter 8.
decisions.reconnection: Both options reach the fixed 25 April P-02 survival baseline.
